query:
SELECT 
  productName,
  expiryDate,
  quantity,
  costPrice,
  (costPrice * quantity) as value
FROM inventory 
WHERE MONTH(createdAt) = 5 AND YEAR(createdAt) = 2026
ORDER BY productName;
